svg.title: Event contracts — services wire to exact versions
svg.text: Event contracts — services wire to exact versions
A service version provides or requires one exact contract version. Drafts move; released versions are frozen.
Event contracts: version-pinned wiring · Colour = model area and relationship kind

g.text: Wiring is between versions, not between names: Billing v2 (draft) moves its pin from v1.0 to v1.1.
Released versions are frozen: Ledger v1 keeps requiring v1.0 until a new Ledger version is drafted.
Diff against the version it was created from
Billing v2 is a draft, so its provider pin can move
from v1.0 to v1.1. Ledger v1 still requires v1.0.
Colour = model area and relationship kind
